mapper.insert:
insert into order_detail (name, image, order_id, dish_id, setmeal_id, dish_flavor, number, amount) values
(#{dl.name}, #{dl.image}, #{dl.orderId}, #{dl.dishId}, #{dl.setmealId}, #{dl.dishFlavor}, #{dl.number}, #{dl.amount})
mapper.select: select od.name, sum(od.number) number from order_detail od join orders where od.order_id = orders.id and orders.status = 5 and orders.order_time >= #{beginTime} and orders.order_time <= #{endTime} group by od.name order by number desc limit 0,10
